title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 2, QA) - Quant - Remainders
subject: Quant

questions.q: When $3^{333}$ is divided by 11, the remainder is
questions.explain: By Fermat's Little Theorem, $3^{10} \equiv 1 \pmod{11}$. We can write $333 = 10 \times 33 + 3$. Thus, $3^{333} = (3^{10})^{33} \times 3^3 \equiv 1^{33} \times 27 \equiv 27 \pmod{11}$. The remainder of 27 divided by 11 is **5**.
